pull_apart.text: She has read my message and still not replied.

scene.known_fact: She read your message a few hours ago and hasn't answered yet.
scene.possible_assumption: That she's upset with you or doesn't care.
scene.alternative_angle: She might be busy, or waiting until she can reply properly.
scene.practical_next_step: Give it until this evening, then send one light check-in.
scene.subtitle_line_1: She's read it and not replied yet. That's the fact.
scene.subtitle_line_2: Why is still an open question, not an answer.

shrink_projection.text: If the presentation goes badly I'm going to get fired.

scene.known_fact: You have a presentation coming up that matters to you.
scene.possible_assumption: That one bad presentation would cost you your job.
scene.alternative_angle: One presentation is rarely the whole story of how someone does their job.
scene.practical_next_step: Run through your opening twice tonight and time it.
scene.subtitle_line_1: A shaky presentation and losing your job are far apart.
scene.subtitle_line_2: What's one part you could rehearse twice tonight?

return_responsibility.text: The party went badly and it's my fault.

scene.known_fact: The party didn't go the way you hoped.
scene.possible_assumption: That how it went was all down to you.
scene.alternative_angle: Parties depend on lots of people, plans and moods at once.
scene.practical_next_step: Ask one guest what they enjoyed most.
scene.subtitle_line_1: A party has lots of moving parts, and you were one.
scene.subtitle_line_2: Which piece of it was really yours to carry?

scene.known_fact: Your presentation didn't go as well as you wanted.
scene.possible_assumption: That the whole thing was a failure.
scene.alternative_angle: Some parts may have landed even if others wobbled.
scene.practical_next_step: Write down one bit that went fine and one to improve.
scene.subtitle_line_1: Between perfect and awful there's a lot of room.
scene.subtitle_line_2: Which part of it actually went fine?

open_interpretations.text: My sister must think I'm selfish.

scene.known_fact: Things have felt tense with your sister lately.
scene.alternative_angle: She might be wrapped up in something of her own right now.
scene.practical_next_step: Ask her how her week has been, and listen.
scene.subtitle_line_1: You know things feel tense, not what she's thinking.
scene.subtitle_line_2: What else could be on her mind right now?

separate_one.text: Nobody ever asks me to join in.

scene.known_fact: Nobody asked you to join in this time.
scene.alternative_angle: This might say more about how this group plans than about you.
scene.practical_next_step: Message one person and suggest a small plan this week.
scene.subtitle_line_1: Not being asked this time is one evening.
scene.subtitle_line_2: Who is one person you could ask first this week?

let_loop_drift.text: I keep replaying the meeting over and over.

scene.known_fact: The meeting is over, and you keep going back to it.
scene.possible_assumption: That replaying it will change how it went.
scene.alternative_angle: Your mind might be trying to protect you, not punish you.
scene.practical_next_step: Write down the one thing you'd do differently, then close the notebook.
scene.subtitle_line_1: Replaying the meeting isn't the same as repairing it.
scene.subtitle_line_2: Is there one thing left to do, or can it rest tonight?

assemble_step.text: I have a deadline on Monday and too much to do.

scene.known_fact: You have a deadline on Monday and a lot left to do.
scene.possible_assumption: That you can't possibly get it all done.
scene.alternative_angle: Not every task needs the same level of polish.
scene.practical_next_step: List the three tasks due first, then start the smallest one.
scene.subtitle_line_1: A Monday deadline is a real problem with real steps.
scene.subtitle_line_2: Which small task could you finish in the next hour?

soften_harshness.text: I failed my driving test. I'm so stupid.

scene.known_fact: You didn't pass your driving test this time.
scene.possible_assumption: That failing once means you're stupid.
scene.alternative_angle: Lots of good drivers needed more than one go.
scene.practical_next_step: Book a lesson that focuses on the part that went wrong.
scene.subtitle_line_1: One test measured one drive on one day.
scene.subtitle_line_2: What would you practise before the next try?

find_boundary.text: My manager took credit for my work. It was so unfair.

scene.known_fact: Your manager presented your work as their own.
scene.possible_assumption: That you just have to let it go.
scene.alternative_angle: Your anger might be pointing at something that needs to change.
scene.practical_next_step: Write down what happened and when, while it's fresh.
scene.subtitle_line_1: Being angry that your work was taken makes sense.
scene.subtitle_line_2: What would you want to say or ask for, if you chose to?
